adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the reference object construction changes `credentialId` from `isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`. For non-calendar integrations (video: Zoom/Meet/Daily, etc., where `isCalendarType` is false), this now stores `undefined` instead of `result.credentialId`, which is a behavior change visible in the diff and can break consumers relying on `reference.credentialId` to identify the video credential.
